photos.caption: NASA's video, clock 15:27:31
photos.how: Frame from NASA's video at 77 s; on-screen clock 04/24/13 15:27:31, wanted 15:27:50 (within 20 s; the matrix time plus one day). NASA's as-run matrix gives this test's start as 'GMT13-113    MSG 15:27:04-15:41' on 2013-04-23 (`as run matrix!B102`), read as 2013-04-23 15:27. The video's on-screen clock reads one day later than the matrix on every day both cover, the same kind of offset NASA states for this clock on BASS-II, so the clock was searched for 2013-04-23 plus one day, 15:27: it was found 45 s into this video, and in no other video. The fan setting on screen (42) is one the matrix's fan cell gives ('42,43,42,41', `as run matrix!J102`).
